title: 6 Office Tasks AI Handles While Your CSR Sleeps

slides.headline: 6 OFFICE TASKS AI HANDLES WHILE YOUR CSR SLEEPS
slides.body: None of these replace her. All of them give her hours back.

slides.headline: 1. AFTER-HOURS PHONE
slides.body: 85% of callers won't leave a voicemail — they call the next shop. AI answers at 11pm, books the no-cool call onto the schedule. Your CSR walks in to a booked job, not a missed one.

slides.headline: 2. MISSED-CALL TEXT-BACK
slides.body: Phone rings out while she's on the other line? A text goes out in seconds: "Sorry we missed you — need service today?" Each saved call is worth $500–$1,200.

slides.headline: 3. JOB NOTES → INVOICE
slides.body: Tech's messy notes become a clean, line-itemed invoice draft in a minute. No decoding chicken scratch, no retyping the same job 3 times. (Demo on yesterday's post.)

slides.headline: 4. ESTIMATE FOLLOW-UP
slides.body: Roughly 70% of quotes walk, and most shops follow up once or never. AI runs the day 1/3/7/14 nudge sequence automatically — she just watches replies come in.

slides.headline: 5. REVIEW REQUESTS & REPLIES · 6. SEASONAL CAMPAIGNS
slides.body: Post-job review asks go out automatically (91% of homeowners check reviews first). And the fall tune-up blast to your customer list? Drafted in minutes, not a lost weekend.

slides.headline: SHE STOPS DROWNING. YOU STOP PAYING FOR TYPING.
slides.body: This is what an AI Profit Audit maps out for YOUR shop — which of the 6 leak the most, in dollars. Want the self-audit version? It's pinned on my page. Or comment CSR and I'll send you this checklist.
